name: Dharma Talk Notes
description: Evidence-aware notes for a Buddhist Dharma talk, study session, or Q&A. Distinguishes direct transcript excerpts from AI summaries and personal practice notes.

sections.title: Talk Context
sections.instruction: Record the title, teacher/speaker, tradition, source, date, and setting only when they are explicitly present in the session metadata or transcript. Mark unavailable details as not stated; never infer lineage or source texts.

sections.title: Main Themes
sections.instruction: Summarize the main themes in neutral language grounded in the transcript. This section is a summary, not a doctrinal ruling or a substitute for the teacher's words.

sections.title: Terms & Explanations
sections.instruction: List Pāli, Sanskrit, Hán–Việt, Vietnamese, or other terms that were explicitly spoken. Preserve uncertain spellings, do not silently normalize them, and include the transcript reference or timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| **Term as heard** | **Explanation given in the talk** | **Reference** |
| --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Direct Transcript Excerpts
sections.instruction: Include only short, exact excerpts supported by the transcript. Every item must contain its timestamp or transcript reference. Do not invent quotations, sutta references, translations, or attributions.

sections.title: Questions & Responses
sections.instruction: List questions and responses that actually appear in the session. If a question is unanswered, label it unresolved rather than supplying an answer.

sections.title: Practice Reflections
sections.instruction: List practices, contemplations, or suggestions explicitly offered in the talk. Clearly phrase this as a session-derived note, not personal advice from the AI.

sections.title: Editor Notes & Items to Verify
sections.instruction: Separate ambiguous audio, uncertain term spellings, and editor notes from the talk itself. Never fill gaps with generated doctrine.
